1. What this system does

A customer writes in the shop's WhatsApp group, for example "laptop battery" or "hi". The system answers by itself: it finds the product (or narrows it down with tap lists), sends the product picture with a private link, and the customer confirms the exact item on a small web page with ACCEPT / REJECT buttons. It then gives the price (from stock, or after asking the shop's vendors on WhatsApp and WeChat), handles bargaining, asks the quantity, creates the sale order in 369ai, sends the signing and payment links, and hands the delivery to a rider with a live tracking link. The shop watches and steps in from a counter screen. Every step is logged: who was asked, who answered, who clicked what and when.

WhoChannelWhat they do
CustomerWhatsApp group of the shopAsks for products, taps menus, confirms on the page, signs, pays, tracks the delivery
Vendor / supplierPrivate WhatsApp chat, or WeChat through the bridge PCGets the picture + page for the exact item, says in stock / no stock, gives the price and delivery time
Shop staff369ai backend: Store counter screen, Delivery, Sales Automation menusSee open enquiries, pick vendors, type a price, accept and pack orders, dispatch riders, watch ratings
RiderTokened link / rider app on the phoneAccepts the job, picks up, delivers with the customer's code, position is tracked

3. Installation

3.1 369ai modules

1. Unzip Odoo_Modules.zip. Copy every folder inside odoo_addons/ into the 369ai addons directory (on the reference server: C:\Program Files\Odoo 19.0.20260403\server\odoo\addons).
2. Restart the 369ai service, open Apps, click Update Apps List.
3. Install Sales Automation - Product Confirmation Page (sales_automation_confirm). It installs the chain automatically: whatsapp_gateway, whatsapp_employee_tracker, sales_automation, sales_automation_delivery, sales_automation_store, sales_automation_insights, sales_automation_wechat.
4. Install Sales Automation - Loyalty on WhatsApp (sales_automation_loyalty): it installs pos_loyalty_card and sale_loyalty_card.
5. Python packages needed by the 369ai Python: requests, Pillow, python-barcode. For the picture search a second Python with Playwright is used (see 3.4).
Never uninstall by deleting a module folder while it is installed. Upgrade a module that adds database columns on its own first (-u thatmodule) before upgrading the ones that depend on it.

3.2 WhatsApp server (gateway + panel)

1. Unzip WhatsApp_Server.zip to C:\whatsapp_server. Install Node.js 20 LTS.
2. Create a PostgreSQL database evolution owned by a separate role (reference: role evoapi) on the same PostgreSQL that 369ai uses. A separate owner keeps it out of 369ai's database list.
3. In C:\whatsapp_server: copy env.example to .env and set the database URL, the authentication key (master key), CACHE_LOCAL_ENABLED=true (no Redis). Then npm install, npx prisma generate --schema prisma\postgresql-schema.prisma, npm run db:deploy:win, npm run build. Start with node dist/main (port 8085).
4. In C:\whatsapp_server\panel: npm install, create .env with PANEL_PORT=8086, PANEL_PUBLIC_URL, PANEL_DATABASE_URL (the same evolution database), EVOLUTION_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8085, the master key, admin user/password. Start with node server.js. Run node reset_panel_admin.js to (re)create the platform administrator.
5. Open the panel as the platform administrator (vendor field empty). Add the software vendor (company + its login), the 369ai server (its base URL as 369ai sees it, e.g. http://localhost:8069), then Add database: one form registers the database (server, name), its user (the client login), its WhatsApp number (the authorized phone, digits with country code; the connection is created and you land on its QR) and its e-mail account. Each database gets its own number this way; a number is shared only if you pick an existing one on that form or tick several databases under Numbers. The database page shows the setup key for 369ai and can register a number later.
6. Pair the number: open the number's Scan / connect page (admin, the vendor, or the database's client login can) and scan the QR with the phone that holds the authorized number. A scan by any other phone is logged out again and refused. The number must be an admin of the customer groups (needed to delete abusive messages).
7. The vendor logs in (vendor name + username + password), sees only its databases and numbers, and fills in each database's e-mail account (SMTP host, user, password, From) and the client's password. The client logs in (vendor name + its username) and sees only its database: number, QR, sender address, activity.
8. On Windows these two are run either as services (nssm) or by hand: Start-Process node -ArgumentList 'dist/main' -WorkingDirectory C:\whatsapp_server and Start-Process node -ArgumentList 'server.js' -WorkingDirectory C:\whatsapp_server\panel.
The panel accepts a request only when the key, the X-Odoo-Url and the X-Odoo-Db all match one registered row (both headers are required). A 403 "token is registered to X, not Y" means the 369ai web.base.url differs from what was registered; it is not a wrong key. A 403 "scanned with A; only B is allowed" means the QR was scanned with the wrong phone: scan again with the authorized one. A 403 "no WhatsApp number assigned" means the administrator has not assigned a number to that database yet.

Roles in the panel

LoginSigns in withSeesCan do
Platform administratorvendor field empty, username + passwordeverythingvendors and their logins, servers, databases, numbers (authorized phone + assignment to one or many databases), client logins, blocked words, all opt-outs. Reset any password with node reset_login.js --admin | --vendor <name> | --db <db> "password".
Vendorvendor name + username + passwordonly its databases and numberseach database's e-mail account and caps, the client's password, its own opt-outs, the QR pages of its numbers
Client (one per database)vendor name + its username + passwordonly its databasescan / reconnect the QR of its number, see the authorized number and sender address (read-only), its activity and opt-outs

One number (one connection to WhatsApp) may serve several databases: they all send on it, and the panel forwards every incoming message to each of them. The same phone number can never be attached to two number records.

3.3 Public address for the phone pages

Customers, vendors and riders open links on their phones: payment, signing, tracking, the product confirmation page, the WeChat vendor page. 369ai therefore needs an https address reachable from the internet. Two ways:

  • Cloudflare named tunnel (recommended): a fixed hostname that survives restarts.
  • Cloudflare quick tunnel (what the test server uses): cloudflared tunnel --no-autoupdate --url http://localhost:8069. The hostname changes at every restart; links sent before a restart stop working.

Put the address in 369ai: Settings ▸ Technical ▸ System Parameters ▸ sa_delivery.public_base_url. Do not change web.base.url: the panel key is registered against it. The WeChat bridge's config.json must carry the same address.

3.4 Picture search (no API key)

The product confirmation page shows real product pictures. When a product has no picture in 369ai, the server searches for one automatically in a headless Chromium (Google Images, and Bing Images when Google shows its robot check). This needs, on the 369ai server, a Python 3.12 with pip install playwright and playwright install chromium. Their paths are set on the Product Confirmation settings page (defaults point at the reference server). A Google Custom Search key is optional and gives the most exact results.

3.5 WeChat bridge PC (optional)

Unzip WeChat_Bridge_DubaiPC.zip on a Windows PC that runs WeChat for Windows 3.9.x (not 4.x) with the shop's WeChat account logged in. Edit config.json (369ai public address, database, the API key from Sales Automation ▸ Configuration ▸ WeChat Bridge, a bridge id). Run install_wechat_bridge.bat as administrator once (it installs Python 3.11 and the packages by itself), then start_wechat_bridge.bat opens the bridge window (369ai light, WeChat light, counters, Translate button 中文/English). Every vendor on WeChat must be a contact whose remark equals the "WeChat contact remark" on the vendor card in 369ai.

4. Configuration in 369ai

4.1 WhatsApp gateway

WhatsApp ▸ Configuration ▸ Sessions: one session per database. Paste the setup key the panel issued for this database and press Load Settings. The session then shows, read-only, the Authorized Number and the Sender Email the panel fixed for this database; 369ai cannot change either, and every e-mail goes out from that address. Load Settings also tells the panel this database's webhook address, so incoming messages arrive without any further step. A status of Wrong Phone Scanned means the QR was scanned with a phone other than the authorized number. The Connections page (Sales Automation ▸ Configuration ▸ Connections) shows the status of every session, the paired and allowed numbers, and the WeChat bridge.

4.2 Sales Automation ▸ Configuration

4.3 Products and categories

Products ▸ Products: the catalogue the customer taps through. On each category: "WhatsApp menu order" and "Hide from the WhatsApp menu" (after the Parent field), and the Vendors list used for price checks. On each product: the picture (used first, before any internet search), the sale price, and attributes (Brand, Capacity, Storage, Colour, Wattage, Size …). Every attribute with more than one value becomes a question the customer answers by tapping before the picture is sent, so the confirmed item is exact (for example "Seagate BarraCuda 2TB Hard Disk 3.5 inch"). Products without attributes are confirmed directly.

4.4 Vendors

Contacts ▸ a vendor: under Sales & Purchase two ticks, WhatsApp and WeChat (a Chinese address ticks WeChat by default), the phone, and the exact WeChat contact remark. Add the vendor to the categories they supply (category form ▸ Vendors) or to the product's Purchase tab.

5. The customer's journey, step by step

5.1 A returning customer says "hi"

Hi 👋 welcome back! What would you like to do? Tap one: 📦 MY ORDERS · 🆕 NEW ORDER · ➕ MORE

MY ORDERS → Pending orders (sign / pay / cancel) and Delivery orders (track). MORE → My loyalty points, My details, Change address. Every list has BACK and MAIN MENU, and a 🙏 THAT'S ALL, THANK YOU when an order is finished. One tap per poll counts; a second tap on the same poll is refused politely.

5.2 NEW ORDER: the catalogue as tap lists

🆕 New order - what are you looking for? Tap a category: Mobile · Laptop · Computer · Computer Spare Parts · Laptop Parts · Mobile Parts · Printers · Printer Spare Parts · ✏️ NOT LISTED · 🏠 MAIN MENU

A category shows its sub-types or its products (six at a time with ➡️ MORE). NOT LISTED lets the customer type what they need, which then goes through the normal understanding below.

5.3 A typed request

Text is classified with the AI and matched to the catalogue. A specific match goes to confirmation. A vague word ("laptop battery", "macbook") opens the guided finder: type → brand → model as tap lists, with "Not listed" to type the exact model. For parts (battery, charger, screen, cover, ink …) a typed brand without a model is followed by one question, "Which model is it for?", and the item becomes for example "Dell Inspiron 15 3520 Laptop Battery".

5.4 Attributes: the exact item

📦 Hard Disk 3.5 inch - which brand? Tap one: WD Blue · Seagate BarraCuda · Toshiba P300 · ✏️ TYPE IT / OTHER
📦 Hard Disk 3.5 inch - which capacity? Tap one: 1TB · 2TB · 4TB · ✏️ TYPE IT / OTHER

TYPE IT / OTHER asks the customer to type. Whatever they type is read against all open questions at once: "seagate 2 tb" answers both; "512 navy" gives 512GB + Navy; a value not in the list with a unit, like "64gb" or "1000w", is kept in the customer's own words and no further question is asked for it; "any" skips a question. The answers resolve to one variant in 369ai.

5.5 The confirmation (picture + page)

📦 Seagate BarraCuda 2TB Hard Disk 3.5 inch Please check the photo and details, then press ACCEPT: https://…/scoped_app/c?db=…&t=… Ref K7

One message: the picture with a short link. The page (section 6) shows up to three pictures, the details table and the ACCEPT / REJECT buttons. Nothing is priced and no vendor is asked until ACCEPT is pressed. A "yes" typed in the chat is answered with "please press ACCEPT on the page" once; after 10 minutes one reminder is sent.

5.6 Price

  • In stock: the shop price is announced at once, with ACCEPT / BETTER PRICE / CANCEL.
  • Not in stock: "Let me check that for you ⏳ … within N minutes". The vendors are asked (section 7). The cheapest reply, plus the margin, is quoted - unless the product already has a sale price and the vendor-based price differs from it: then the customer hears "Still checking …" and Store ▸ Enquiries shows "Two prices - approve one" (🏷 product page 510.00 · 🚚 vendor 300.00 + 30 % = 390.00) with Use page price / Use vendor price / Type another; the tap is confirmed once more ("Quote the customer 510.00 for #Ref? This becomes the order and invoice price") and only then is the customer quoted. The vendor's quote never changes the product page. Settings: AI Settings ▸ Vendor ▸ Shop approves when the vendor price differs and Ignore differences under (%). No reply - or nobody to ask (no vendor with a WhatsApp / WeChat tick on the category) → the enquiry is parked for the shop to type a price: Store ▸ Enquiries shows a Needs a price card with an alarm and the reason, and the escalation phone gets the tokened price link. The customer hears "Still checking on … for you ⏳". Nothing is ever dropped silently.

5.7 Bargaining

BETTER PRICE steps the price down by the configured percentage, a limited number of times, never below the minimum margin. Products with their own quantity ranges (product form ▸ WhatsApp Bargaining, e.g. 5–9 pcs 2 %, 10–20 pcs 5 %) ask the quantity first and show BETTER PRICE only inside a range; the range discount is applied once.

5.8 Quantity, summary, order

📋 Order summary Seagate BarraCuda 2TB Hard Disk 3.5 inch 2 x 30.00 Total: 60.00 CONFIRM · CHANGE

CHANGE offers CHANGE QUANTITY / BETTER PRICE / KEEP / CANCEL. CONFIRM creates the sale order in 369ai (in the employee session's company, with the exact variant on the line) and posts its number.

5.9 Customer details, sign, pay, deliver

Every order, straight after "Done! Your order is placed", the bot collects the customer's details in the group, one question at a time:

👤 What name should the quotation be in? 🏠 Thanks Angitha. What is your full address? 📮 And your pincode? (only in countries that use one) 📋 Please check your details 👤 Angitha · 🏠 Building 12, Al Khuwair, Muscat · 📮 111 · 📱 917907543611 Tap one: ✅ YES, CORRECT · ✏️ NO, CHANGE · ❌ CANCEL

NO, CHANGE asks which field (👤 NAME / 🏠 ADDRESS / ⬅️ BACK); only that field is asked again and the check comes back. The customer contact in 369ai is written from these answers, so a quotation is never raised in the name of a phone number. Then:

  • ✍️ Sign: "Details saved - please sign your order" with the order's portal page. The signature confirms the order; the confirmed order PDF is posted in the group ("📄 Order S000xx - confirmed").
  • Goods in stock: the payment link is posted the moment it is signed.
  • Goods to be sourced: "we are arranging the goods"; the payment link follows when the shop accepts the order on the counter screen (goods in hand).
  • Loyalty: before the payment link the customer may be offered USE POINTS / PAY FULL (section 11).
  • After payment: TRACK THIS ORDER / MY ORDERS / MAIN MENU / THAT'S ALL. The delivery job goes to a rider; the customer gets the tracking link and a delivery code (section 9).

6. Product confirmation page and pictures

6.1 The page

A private link per enquiry and person (customer, each vendor). It opens one mobile page: the main picture, a strip of up to three pictures (tap to switch, tap the big picture to zoom, pinch to zoom), the details table (product, reference, quantity, chosen brand / capacity / colour, code, barcode, category, price when known, weight, description) and below it the two buttons ACCEPT / REJECT. The first press is final: the page then shows "Accepted ✔ date time by who" with both buttons disabled, and a later press is refused and logged. Vendor pages are bilingual English / Chinese.

6.2 Where the pictures come from

  1. The product's (or variant's) own picture in 369ai - always first. Add photos on the product form for the best result.
  2. Variant images tab (Sales ▸ Products ▸ Product Variants ▸ open the variant): several photos of that exact variant. The first is the main picture when the variant has no image of its own; the next ones fill the strip (three in total). The Variant specs tab next to it is the table shown under the picture: it is filled from the attributes (Processor: Core i3, Memory: 8GB …) - press Fill from attributes on older variants - and you may edit the values, add lines (Warranty: 1 year) or reorder them; an edited line replaces the attribute value on the page.
  3. Automatic search by the exact item name in a headless Chromium: Google Images, then Bing Images when Google shows its robot check. Results are ranked: the chosen values (brand, capacity…) count for a result, sibling values (a "8GB 16GB 32GB" seller collage) count against it. The first result is saved on the product / variant, two other shots are kept for the strip.
  4. Google Custom Search (optional key), then free sources (Openverse, Wikipedia, Wikimedia Commons), then a product page found by Gemini, then a Gemini-drawn reference picture. If nothing: the page says "No photo yet" and still works.

6.3 The click log

Every open and every press is recorded with the account the link was sent to, the time, the IP address and the browser: Sales Automation ▸ Enquiries ▸ Confirmation Links and Link Clicks; on the enquiry form ("Confirmation links"); on the counter screen's enquiry detail ("Confirmation page" block); on the Insights profiles ("Opened / ACCEPTED the product page").

7. Vendors: WhatsApp and WeChat

7.1 WhatsApp vendor

🔎 Price check #K7 Seagate BarraCuda 2TB Hard Disk 3.5 inch x 2 See the details and press ACCEPT if you have this exact product: https://…

ACCEPT on the page = "I have it" → "👍 Good - what is your best price?" → the vendor types "450" or "450 3 days". REJECT = no stock. Typed YES / NO and prices still work. Replies carry #REF when the vendor has several open checks. The cheapest quote wins when the window closes; the vendor is thanked.

7.2 WeChat vendor (through the bridge)

Price check #K7 Seagate BarraCuda 2TB Hard Disk 3.5 inch Qty: 2 Do you have it? 1 = In stock 2 = No stock 询价 #K7 … 有货吗？ 1 = 有货 / 2 = 没有 👉 Confirm / 确认: https://…

The bridge sends the picture first, then this text. The vendor taps the page or replies 1 / 2, then the price ("45" or "45 3"), then the delivery time (1 = ready stock, 2 = 1-3 days, 3 = 4-7 days, 4 = more than 7 days). Plain words are understood too ("I have it", "not available", "有货", "没有"). A "no" then "I have it" reopens the vendor. The thanks ends with "Our store manager will contact you soon".

When the bridge is down for longer than the stale minutes, the counter screen shows a "WeChat - relay by hand" block: Copy the message, mark Sent by hand, or type the price the vendor gave.

7.3 Vendor groups and the enquiry desk

Vendor WhatsApp groups per category receive the same price check as one post. With "shop picks vendors" on, out-of-stock enquiries park on the counter screen for a person to tick the vendors (auto-sent after the timeout).

8. The shop counter (Store)

Store ▸ Shop Queue: the live screen with an alarm. Cards for new orders to accept and pack (pickup code shown), enquiries waiting for a price or a vendor choice, stalled enquiries, WeChat relay rows. Each card opens the enquiry detail: the vendors table, the customer thread, the supplier thread, the confirmation page block and the clocks. Store ▸ Enquiries: the parked out-of-stock enquiries where a person ticks vendors. Store ▸ New Orders: orders to confirm before a rider is paged (when "shop confirms" is on): Accept sends the customer "approved" and, for unpaid group orders, the payment link; Ready pages the rider.

9. Delivery: five buttons, two codes

Delivery ▸ Deliveries (To Dispatch, In Progress, Create OTP, Delivered, Failed, Same Day, Express, All), Riders & Couriers, Shops, Delivery Codes, App Sessions, Delivery Analysis, Delivery Settings. A paid, signed order becomes a delivery job when the flow goes that far: Delivery ▸ Configuration ▸ Delivery Settings ▸ WhatsApp order flow ends at chooses the last step every WhatsApp order does by itself - Order confirmed (signed order PDF in the group, no payment link), Invoice sent (invoice posted and sent in the group, no payment link), Payment received (pay link at the signature, paid invoice in the group, no delivery job - the delivery order is validated by hand in Inventory) or Delivered (the full flow below). Before Delivered nothing appears under Delivery or on the Shop Queue. The Same Day / Express / To Dispatch cards show the job code, the sale order number, a green Paid or red Unpaid - collect … badge read live from the invoices and payments, and the current step; the newest day is listed first. Every time shown follows the browser's clock: on login the user's timezone preference is set to the browser's zone, so the screen, the WhatsApp texts and the promised dates agree. Call a Rider mode (Delivery Settings): Ask each time (a list with an Auto button and tick boxes), Automatic (nearest free rider, no list), Automatic - only within the radius (never outside the km radius), Manual (tick one or several riders in the table; they are called one at a time and nobody else). Calling a rider (3 Oct): after Packed the job waits at Ready until Call a Rider is pressed (job form or Shop Queue): pick a rider yourself, or Auto calls the nearest free rider to the shop's map pin - the longest idle one when two are about equally near, a random one when exactly equal. One rider at a time, never all; no answer within the time limit and the next rider is called. Delivery ▸ Configuration ▸ Riders & Couriers shows the fleet as On duty - free / On duty - busy / Off duty with each rider's last position as an area name. Set each shop's map pin under Delivery ▸ Configuration ▸ Shops. The job form and the Store ▸ Shop Queue card show one or two buttons at a time, in this order, and every button explains itself when you hold the mouse on it (ⓘ).

StepButtonWhat happensCustomer hears
0Store ▸ Shop Queue ▸ Accept → PackedThe parcel is packed.-
1Job form ▸ Generate Pickup Code (also: Shop Queue ▸ Generate pickup code, or Delivery ▸ Create OTP)A 6-digit code appears on the job itself, big, with a copy icon, and is sent to the rider's WhatsApp when the job has a rider. Valid 15 minutes.-
2DispatchPick the rider (if the job has none) and type the code the rider shows you → status Collected by Rider."🚚 Rider has collected your order #D16 and is on the way" + tracking link
3Rider Near CustomerStatus Rider Near Customer."🛵 Rider is near your location with order #D16. Please be ready to receive it."
4Reached Customer LocationThe delivery code is sent to the customer now; the form shows Reached at HH:MM. Resend Customer Code makes a fresh one."📦 Your order is arriving. Give this code to the rider after you have the parcel: 123456"
5DeliveredType the code the customer gave the rider → Delivered, stock transfer validated, order closed."✅ Delivered. Thank you!"
-FailedReason (customer absent / refused / wrong address …) → Failed; the job stays open to retry or return."⚠ We could not deliver your order … we will contact you"

The rider's own WhatsApp page has the same four steps: Collect (type the pickup code) → I am near the customer → Reached - send the code → Delivered (type the customer's code). The rider app (later) uses the same server actions. A delivery manager also has Force buttons without codes; every force is logged in the chatter.

9.1 The job form

The blue line under the title says where the job is and which button comes next. Only the buttons of the current step are shown; hold the mouse on a button to read what it does.

9.2 The Shop Queue card

The same five steps on the counter screen, with the pickup code shown on the card and an ⓘ on every button.

9.3 Delivery ▸ Create OTP

Choose the order (S000xx, customer or job code D42), Pickup / Dispatch or Delivery, and whether to send it on WhatsApp. Generate shows the code in big digits with a copy button. Delivery ▸ Configuration ▸ Delivery Codes lists every code issued (never the digits).

10. Payment, signing and the order

  • Quotation (not yet confirmed): the portal page offers Accept & Sign and payment through the enabled payment providers (Demo provider in test mode on the test database).
  • Confirmed order: the portal page has no Pay button any more; the system sends 369ai's payment link (/my/orders/<id>?…&payment_amount=…) which shows the payment form.
  • The pay page, sign page, tracking page and confirmation page all go through a database doorway so a phone that never saw the server lands on the right database.
  • Payment reserved on a card at ordering and captured at delivery is supported where the provider allows it (GCC providers differ; see the payment module notes).

11. Loyalty points

One loyalty ledger for POS and sales (pos_loyalty_card + sale_loyalty_card). Points are earned when an order is paid, taken back on a credit note, redeemed on a quotation with the Redeem wizard, and on WhatsApp offered before the payment link: "🎁 You have N points (worth X). Use them on order #REF?" → USE POINTS / PAY FULL. The card number is masked in groups. After payment: "🎁 You earned N points · balance B". Menus: Sales ▸ Loyalty (cards, rules, history), Sales Automation ▸ Configuration ▸ Loyalty on WhatsApp.

12. Insights, ratings and the conduct filter

Insights ▸ Customer Dashboard / Vendor Dashboard: a ranked board with automatic 1–5 ★ ratings computed nightly from behaviour only (reply speed, conversion, completion, cancellations, bargaining, payment; for vendors reply rate and speed, win rate, promise kept, price, conduct), tiers Best / Better / Normal / Poor / New with filter chips, day / night theme. Click a row for the profile: orders with progress, enquiries (expand for the full thread), timeline, heatmap, logs including the confirmation-page clicks, and the customer's WhatsApp chat log by day. Tick 2–4 rows to compare. Insights ▸ Configuration ▸ Remarks: the conduct filter's records. Abusive messages (English, Arabic, Malayalam, Hindi, Tamil word lists on the AI Settings page) are deleted in WhatsApp (the number must be a group admin), the sender is warned and gets a remark that lowers the rating.

Speed of the delete. A listed word, phrase or adult link is removed the moment it arrives. A doubtful word (rude only sometimes, e.g. "loosu", "mental", "fool") is also removed at once - the AI model is asked afterwards only to grade the remark, never to hold the message (setting Doubtful messages: Delete at once; the older "ask the model first" behaviour is still selectable). The model call has its own short timeout (6 s). A word that is in no list is left alone: add it to Words (always removed) or Doubtful Words (removed, graded afterwards).

Design rules learned on the reference server

  • Never commit the request cursor inside a webhook, and never read on one connection a row committed by another during the same request (REPEATABLE READ). Identifiers that must survive a retried request are derived deterministically (the confirmation token is an HMAC of enquiry + person).
  • Never name a model method _table or another attribute 369ai reads on the class.
  • Every message the customer can act on within seconds must be created before slow work (picture search) continues; the page retries while the row is not there yet.
  • Every byte stored in an image field is verified as a real JPEG / PNG first.
  • 369ai search views refuse <group>; t-inherit template errors surface only in the browser; adding a state means editing every literal state tuple.
  • Reactivating an archived product template does not reactivate its variants.
  • Rolled-back shell tests (savepoint + mocked senders + gateway pointed at a dead port) are the way to verify flows on a live database; the packaged test files are in the working copies folder.

Reference server: 369ai 19 on Windows, PostgreSQL 12, database res-test1. Working copies of every module and script: D:\mydata\sa_working_copies. Backups before catalogue changes: res-test1-before-catalogue-clean.dump.

Zero is off, which is what this did before: only the 24-hour sweep closes an abandoned enquiry, and nothing tells the customer.

Keep it generous. A customer reading WhatsApp between jobs is normal, and a closed enquiry means their tap on ACCEPT lands on nothing.

Manual: the list opens, the counter ticks one or several riders; they are called one at a time, nearest free first, and nobody else is called.
Call a rider automatically at Packed
auto_call_rider_on_packed		on / offFalseOn: the moment the counter presses Packed, the nearest free rider is called. Off (default): the job waits at Ready until somebody presses Call a Rider and either picks a rider or lets Auto choose.
Search radius (km)
dispatch_radius_km		number5.0Free riders inside this distance from the shop are called first, nearest first. 0 = no limit. Riders outside the radius are only called when nobody inside is free.
A position counts for (minutes)
position_max_age_minutes		number30A rider whose last GPS fix is older than this is treated as 'position unknown' and ranks after everyone with a fresh fix.
Rider must answer within (seconds)
offer_timeout_seconds		number60No Accept within this time: the next candidate is called and this rider is not asked again for the same job.
Riders tried before stopping
max_offer_rounds		number5After this many unanswered offers the job waits for the counter.
Address lookup
geocode_provider		choiceOpenStreetMap (Nominatim, free)Turns a rider's GPS position into 'Area, City' for the fleet view.
Google Maps API key
geocode_google_key		text(set)-
Firebase service account (JSON)
fcm_service_account_json		text (several lines)(set)Firebase console > Project settings > Service accounts > Generate new private key. Paste the whole JSON. Empty = no push; the rider app still sees the offer on its next refresh and on WhatsApp.
Firebase project
fcm_project		text(set)-
Last push error
fcm_last_error		text(set)-
WhatsApp order flow ends at
flow_end		choiceDelivered - the full flow: rider, pickup code, delivery codeEvery WhatsApp order runs: order signed -> invoice -> payment -> delivery. Pick the last step this shop does by itself. Before 'Delivered' no delivery job is raised: the delivery order stays a plain 369ai transfer that the shop validates by hand.
Offer Quick Delivery
quick_enabled		on / offTrueWhen every line of the order is in stock at the chosen shop, the delivery is promised within the hours below instead of the express lead time.
Quick Delivery Within (hours)
quick_hours		number4Promised time when the goods are already on the shelf. Four hours is a working half-day; set it to the time a rider realistically needs across your service area, not the best case.
Express Delivery Within (days)
express_days		number3Promised time when something has to be ordered in from a supplier first. This is what the customer is told, so it should include the supplier's own lead time, not just your dispatch.
Return OTPs in the API (testing only)
otp_test_mode		on / offTrueHands the pickup and delivery codes back in the API response so the flow can be driven from Postman while no WhatsApp session is connected.

Leave this OFF anywhere real: with it on, anyone holding a rider's token can read the code that proves a customer received their parcel. Every use is written to the log.
Tell the Customer the Date
promise_customer		on / offTrueInclude the promised date in the WhatsApp message and on the tracking page. Turn it off if you would rather not commit to a date in writing.
Same-Day Cut-off (hour, 0-23)
cutoff_hour		number16An in-stock order confirmed after this hour is promised for the next day rather than today. 16 means anything after 4pm rolls over. Set 0 to promise the quick window whatever the time.
Shop Confirms Orders
shop_confirms		on / offTrueOn, a paid order waits on the shop's screen until somebody accepts it and says it is packed. Only then is a rider called.

Off, the rider is called the moment the order is paid - which is right for a business where the same person packs and delivers, and wrong for anywhere a rider can arrive before the goods are off the shelf.
Ring For (seconds)
alarm_ring_seconds		number30How long one ring lasts. The screen beeps continuously for this long, rests for the repeat interval, and rings again until the order is accepted.
Alarm Repeats Every (s)
alarm_repeat_seconds		number10How often the shop screen sounds while an order is waiting. It keeps sounding until every waiting order has been accepted - one alarm for the queue, not one per order.
No-Reply Ring For (seconds)
stalled_ring_seconds		number30How long one no-reply alarm lasts before it rests.
No-Reply Alarm Repeats Every (minutes)
stalled_repeat_minutes		number2The gap between no-reply alarms. Minutes, not seconds: somebody has to phone a supplier before this card can be cleared, and beeping every ten seconds while they are on the phone only gets the speakers turned off.
Stop the No-Reply Alarm After (minutes)
stalled_alarm_minutes		number10Zero means never stop.
Remind About Waiting Stock At (hour)
supply_remind_hour		number9Hour of the morning, 0-23, in your own timezone. Each shop is sent one WhatsApp listing everything it is still waiting for, and the counter screen rings.
Keep Reminding For (days)
supply_remind_days		number0Stop chasing an order this many days after the suppliers were asked. Zero keeps reminding until somebody marks the goods arrived - which is the honest default, because the order is still owed to a customer either way.
Enquiry Ring For (seconds)
enquiry_ring_seconds		number30How long one enquiry alarm lasts before it rests.
Enquiry Alarm Repeats Every (s)
enquiry_repeat_seconds		number10The quiet gap between enquiry alarms.
Stop the Enquiry Alarm After (minutes)
enquiry_alarm_minutes		number3Unlike the packing alarm, this one gives up. A counter that has been beeping for an hour is a counter where somebody has turned the speakers off.

Zero means never stop.
Decide Quick or Express by reach, stock and area
qe_enabled		on / offTrueOn: an order is Quick when a shop that does Quick, within its reach of the customer's map pin, holds every line; otherwise the customer's pincode area decides. Off: the order's own warehouse stock decides, as before.
Add the delivery fee when the order is confirmed
qe_auto_fee		on / offFalseOff (default): the fee is added only when somebody presses Add delivery fee on the order, so a total the customer has already agreed on WhatsApp does not change.
Refuse a Quick order below the minimum
qe_enforce_minimum		on / offFalseOff (default): an order below the Quick minimum is only flagged.
